title: Regenerate only the stage that failed
statement: When a check rejects a draft, regenerate only the stage that failed and pass the specific reason, not a generic 'try again'.
detail: Two staged designs put a deterministic check between generation stages: a lab directive of 19 May 2026 had the validator re-ask only the failing stage instead of restarting, and the parallel lab's question-set architecture ended its validator with 'repair or regenerate with specific reason'. The solver lab's action packet recommended regenerating with concrete rejection reasons between stages, not a broad 'try again'. Neither variant was measured in the records read.
against: The same directive took the opposite line on reasons: "the question-generator doesn't see the validator's reasoning, only the reject signal." (icloud-work/aptraining/workspace/comms/to_den/2026-05-19T1541Z_gate0_prototype_in_lab.md, line 39).
